stance_rationale: Forge produces useful numerical regressions, but the package is not admission-grade because same-period baseline fairness, DSR penalty consistency, lockbox visualization, chart artifacts, and canonical schedule integrity are unresolved. The weakest failures are process-governance failures, not a lack of headline SR.

critical_concerns.description: Same-period baseline fairness fails: L-279 baseline is documented with n=256 while reproduced Forge run has n=254, and there is no evidence that baseline was recomputed with identical period, identical 15bps cost, and identical DSR penalty.

DSR penalty is not role-prompt compliant: Forge uses Bailey-LdP M=30 scan, but does not reconcile alpha+optimizer candidates_tried=5, does not apply the required candidates_tried x 0.05 convention, and does not apply the same penalty to baseline.

Lockbox proof is incomplete: sr_lockbox_daily_harness is null, output/ contains no equity_curve.png, no lockbox marker/strategy line can be inspected, and no Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined split is reported.

Canonical schedule integrity is not admission-grade: user-specified mailbox weights.csv sums to 4.08-10.485 with 117-300 tickers per date, while stage weights.csv sums to 1 but still holds 29 names on all 268 dates and lacks method_selected.

Requested covariance path qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260518_002/covariance.parquet is absent; the primary covariance under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260518_002 is PSD with cond 22.856, but artifact-path ambiguity remains unresolved.

RF-F9 rationalization risk remains: Forge leans on inherited L-279 panel, inherited infeasibility handling, and r_H_renorm handling 41% missing TSMOM history rather than proving current-cycle hard-constraint-clean walk-forward admission.

supporting_arguments: Alpha/risk/optimization package md5 hashes match the Forge start/end audit.
alpha_scores.parquet exists in both A/B alpha paths with 63,851 rows and 268 signal dates; Usable_Date <= Date holds.
Primary covariance.parquet is PSD with eigenvalues [0.044957144286, 0.0033881696909, 0.0019669661734] and condition number 22.8560841023 <= 100.
Harvey 5-spec is complete for CAPM, Carhart3_FF3, Carhart4, FF5, and FF6 at both lag3 and lag12.
Turnover cost formula uses 15bps x 2 round-trip, not the known x12 error.
unresolved_disputes: Which weights.csv is canonical for Forge admission: mailbox 63,851-row invalid panel or stage 7,772-row 29-instrument schedule.
Whether L-279 precedent can override max_names=20 hard, ETF/bond universe exceptions, and turnover above 600% without Judge/Governor approval.
Whether M=30 Bailey-LdP DSR is acceptable when the Forge critic prompt mandates candidates_tried x 0.05 consistency and baseline penalty parity.
Whether lockbox proof can pass without equity_curve/oos_zoom charts and explicit Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined metrics.
Whether the stated 880 unique assets claim is defensible when alpha_scores.parquet contains 576 unique tickers.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest assumption is that inherited L-279 precedent plus pending governance exceptions can substitute for a current-cycle, same-period, lockbox-visible, hard-constraint-clean Forge admission package.
rebuttal_required: Provide one canonical weights.csv with as_of_date, ticker, weight, method_selected and prove sum=1, n_names<=20, 0<=w<=0.20, long-only for every date.
Recompute baseline on the exact Forge period with identical cost and identical DSR penalty, or label the comparison as documented-only.
Emit equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png with lockbox marker and visible post-2024-01-23 strategy line.
Add explicit Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined metrics, including sr_lockbox_daily_harness or a documented infeasibility reason.
Resolve DSR penalty methodology against RF-F5, including baseline penalty parity.
rationalization_red_flags: L-279 admit precedent panel inherited 그대로

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge metrics are numerically strong, but AX-008 cannot pass while Forge itself marks Codex and Architect as pending and the package misses baseline parity, lockbox chart evidence, and canonical schedule compliance.
